Yes, the business cards in the "Meet the businesses building BlakNet" section have **visible drop shadows**. They appear as soft, subtle shadows that lift the cards slightly off the background, giving them a layered, elevated appearance.

The font is **sans-serif throughout** (no serif headings). The entire page uses a clean sans-serif typeface for all text elements—including the large hero headlines ("Built for Black Business"), section headings ("From visibility to opportunity"), card titles ("Mabuya Accounting Partners"), and body copy.

**Concise summary:**
- **Drop shadows:** Yes, visible on all business cards.
- **Font:** Sans-serif exclusively; no serifs anywhere on the page.
